gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Quirky, storybook letters with open jaws. Noto Sans Palmyrene takes over with curves that stop short of closing, leaving the display heading's nostalgia to Mystery Quest alone.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-h: Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curved stroke, a bookish, old-tale look. And Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau gives it a modern foil, with curves left open to breathe beneath.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Nostalgic is the first word for Mystery Quest, with its open-jawed curves and compact ascenders. Yet Noto Sans PhagsPa feels contemporary and approachable beside it, like a friendly neighbor to an old storybook.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-phoenicia: Noto Sans Phoenician is modern and plain. Its s curves open wide at both ends, while Mystery Quest keeps a bookish, nostalgic mood that gives the pair its real strength.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-psalter-p: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi is approachable and plain. Next to it, Mystery Quest feels bookish and nostalgic, its open jaws and compact ascenders trading looks with those gaping e shapes and barely rising capitals.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang reads professionally and contemporary, its lowercase counters like wide glass portholes with open gaps in every curve. Mystery Quest can go larger above it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads as modern and plain, with a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves. Over pages it would stay easygoing.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan is sturdy and approachable. Mystery Quest is best at bookish, nostalgic display with its open-jawed curves, while the hefty lowercase here carries the daylight-filled everyday text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-saurashtr: Open jaws mark every curved stroke of Mystery Quest. Beneath it, Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps capitals barely taller than their neighbors, so the bookish heading and the clean sans-serif text sit together comfortably.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-sc: Nostalgic through and through, Mystery Quest leads with open jaws and compact ascenders. Noto Sans SC follows in chalk-like curves that stop before closing, so a long passage would feel modern and unhurried.
